# Exact _make_pkglist from installed Archiso 92-1 /usr/bin/mkarchiso (unchanged since 90-1).
# Source pin: 8e3ead17e1e5cfde503534d23be918b8787d3dd3.
_make_pkglist() {
    _msg_info "Creating a list of installed packages on live-enviroment..."
    case "${buildmode}" in
        "bootstrap")
            pacman -Q --sysroot "${pacstrap_dir}" \
                | _unshare install -m 0644 /dev/stdin "${bootstrap_parent}/pkglist.${arch}.txt"
            ;;
        "iso"|"netboot")
            install -d -m 0755 -- "${isofs_dir}/${install_dir}"
            pacman -Q --sysroot "${pacstrap_dir}" >"${isofs_dir}/${install_dir}/pkglist.${arch}.txt"
            ;;
    esac
    _msg_info "Done!"
}
